svg.title: Pressurehall Passage — Three pressure bellows
svg.desc: Three bellows chambers are separated by relief galleries. Valve decks, maintenance carts and hanging service cradles stay behind the marked steam discharge lanes. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
